Photo 0: a dark, semi-translucent controller rests on the console; an Xbox logo button is visible on it, but no cable is visible running from it.
Photo 0: cables, a power strip, and an orange tool/charger are visible around the console, none clearly belonging to the console's own power brick.

Photo 1: a console 'Games' library screen reads '11 games' and shows 11 titles (Assassin's Creed Black Flag, Batman, CTR, FC 25, Far Cry 6, Inside, Sifu, Titanfall 2, Tomb Raider, Watch Dogs 2, World War Z).
No serial number, model sticker, storage-capacity screen, or disc-slot view is visible in either photo.

identity.kind: Xbox One S style game console with one controller

claims.evidence: No region sticker, plug type, or import label visible in either photo.
Photo 1 shows a library screen listing 11 games, matching the count, but nothing confirms these are playable offline without an online Xbox Live/account check.
Photo 0 shows a controller with a translucent shell and no visible cable; its shape is consistent with a standard wireless Xbox controller rather than a wired one.

risks.risk: Console may not power on or may have internal fault (common issue bought 'as seen')
risks.proof: A video of the console being switched on and showing the Xbox boot/dashboard screen.

risks.risk: Disc drive presence/condition unknown - may be the disc-less 'All-Digital' edition, which is worth less
risks.proof: A clear photo of the front edge/disc slot of the console.

risks.risk: Storage capacity unknown (affects resale value, common sizes 500GB/1TB)
risks.proof: A photo of the Settings > System > Storage screen.

risks.risk: Controller may be wireless, not wired as claimed, or may need new batteries/pairing
risks.proof: A photo showing a USB cable attached to the controller, or a clip of it being used wired.
risks.if_unproven: priced as wireless controller with unknown battery/pairing condition

risks.risk: Games may be tied to the seller's Xbox Live account and not transferable/offline-playable permanently
risks.proof: A screenshot of account/profile settings showing games licensed to the console itself (offline license) rather than streamed via Game Pass or tied to login.

risks.risk: Cosmetic condition (scratches, cracks, yellowing) not fully visible due to camera angle
risks.proof: Straight-on photos of all four sides and the top vents.

risks.risk: Power brick/cable included or functional is not shown
risks.proof: A photo of the official Xbox power brick and cable included in the sale.
risks.if_unproven: priced as missing power supply (needs replacement)

proof_requests: Video of the console powering on and reaching the Xbox dashboard.
Photo of the front edge showing whether there is a disc slot.
Screenshot of Settings > System > Storage showing capacity.
Photo of the controller showing a USB cable attached, if truly wired.
Photo of the power brick/cable included.
Straight-on photos of all sides of the console for cosmetic condition.
response.reason: The item is identifiable as an Xbox One S style console with one controller and a visible 11-game library, but no photo proves it powers on, confirms disc drive/storage, or shows a wired controller as claimed, so it must be priced at worst case (untested, all-digital, wireless, unverified game licenses) pending further proof.
